title: Click-limited links, plus fix for idempotent replay of deleted links
description: Enhancement: allow a link to stop working after N clicks (one-time or limited-use links). Bug fix: replaying an Idempotency-Key after its link was deleted returns 200 with a dead short URL.
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/v1/urls accepts optional max_clicks (1..1,000,000); responses include max_clicks
After max_clicks redirects, the link returns 410 with 'link has reached its click limit'
Links without max_clicks behave exactly as before
Click-limited links are never served from the redirect cache
Databases created by v1 are migrated automatically on startup; existing links keep working
Bug: replaying an Idempotency-Key whose link was deleted returns 410, not 200
assumptions: The limit is approximate under concurrent clicks: clicks are counted after the redirect, so simultaneous requests can exceed the limit by the number of in-flight requests
No backfill: existing links get max_clicks = NULL (unlimited)
non_functional: Redirect latency for unlimited links unchanged
out_of_scope: Strict exactly-N enforcement (needs a transactional counter)
